brief.name: Smart Bucket Hat
brief.pitch: A Bucket Hat with an embedded LED matrix that acts as a user-programmable marquee for text and animations and a built-in BLE beacon for tracking in crowded environments (festivals).
brief.what: A common yet fashionable bucket hat with an embedded matrix of RGB LEDs all around the head that uses a Bluetooth-connected microcontroller for displaying text and animations defined in a companion app for your phone. The same microcontroller can act as a location-aware beacon for friends to locate you at crowded events like festivals.
brief.who: Marketed towards anglers, tiki enthusiasts, burning man attendees, festival goers, attentions-seekers, party people.
brief.electronics: NRF52840, flexible RGB LED matrix (hub 75 or neopixel matrix), battery, matrix LED driver
brief.design: It's an existing format of headwear (bucket hat) just augmented by electronics.
